thread:
anya: t-minus 15. dimmed lights in console; please confirm quiet handoff and who’s on the emergency unpin lane. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
miguel: I’ve verified EU fleet is in silent mode, no background jobs. canary traffic is at 0.5% and healthy. metrics green.
sara: release notes link: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2026-03-21. last-minute change: removed experimental batching flag from v3.4.2.
anya: thanks. @alex you own rollback decision if latency > 150ms for 2 consecutive minutes, correct?
alex: yes. threshold set in the runbook. if breach -> pin + rollback to v3.4.1. I’ll be watching traces.
deploy-bot: deploy started for service-search v3.4.2 -> nodes: 36, canary: 18, region: us-east-1.
lena: double-checked secrets and KMS rotation. private deployment handoff acknowledged. :white_check_mark: 
miguel: quick smoke command I ran: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status` -> OK
anya: ops play: if error rate > 1% AND error budget < 30% in last 10m, trigger manual rollback. alex -> you will give the go/no-go?
alex: agreed. I’ll call rollback if I see sustained tail latency spikes or error budget drain. ping me with traces link.
ops-bot: alert threshold set: latency_p95 > 150ms (120s window); error_rate > 1% (10m). Slack alert channel = #incidents.
anya: small checklist before we close: 1) pinlist checked? 2) canary observed 5min? 3) release notes posted? 4) fallback route ready?
sara: 1) pinlist yes (search, embed, re-ranker). 2) canary 8min and stable. 3) notes posted. 4) fallback route to v3.4.1 configured and smoke tested.
miguel: perf counters: QPS steady, GPU mem stable. no kv-cache pressure.
alex: I see one small spike at +3m in tail but recovered < 30s. not actionable.
anya: ok closing quiet window in 5. keep comms to essentials. if you egress, call out with :phone: and reason.
deploy-bot: canary advanced to 25% at 3109992300.
lena: verifying autoscale behavior for dedicated pools. all good.
miguel: reroute config ready if we need to divert eu traffic to us-west.
sara: noted minor doc fix in release notes (typo) — not blocking.
alex: backup rollback command pinned: `./scripts/rollback.sh search v3.4.1 --force --reason "latency spike"`
anya: final check - who is primary oncall for the next 30m?
ops-bot: primary oncall = alex, secondary = miguel.
anya: perfect. locking the runway. keep messages short unless action required. :rocket: 
miguel: will post a 15m post-launch readout when stable.
anya: thanks team — lights back to dimmed until we hit steady state.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: search v3.4.2 at 3109992375; canary -> 100% successful; no automatic rollbacks triggered.
